what: Round 3's `sysroot_attr` (hir-expand/src/fixture.rs:626-642) gives every fixture crate with no std dependency and no core a `no_core` crate attribute. rustc gates `no_core` (E0658 'the `no_core` attribute is an experimental feature' at `<crate attribute>:1:4`), so each such crate's check now gets that error: 579 of blaze-diagnostics' 774 round-6 failures (9023f3e6d7) carry it, e.g. tests::items::macros::a_macro_that_does_not_exist_is_not_found and tests::bodies::members::a_field_a_struct_lacks. Wanted: the crate the fixture marks so that rustc's injected `extern crate std;`/prelude is not asked for stays free of a user-visible gate: give it `feature(no_core)` beside `no_core` (how `-Zcrate-attr=no_core` UI tests write it), or mark it in the crate graph rather than as a crate attribute. A test that wants a gate on a `#![no_core]` it writes still sees it. No blaze-diagnostics change needed once this lands.
